interface.longDescription: Connects ChatGPT to the exact pinned DesktopCommanderMCP runtime on Lappy through VeraMesh Secure MCP Tunnel. Desktop Commander owns the filesystem, search, editing, process, configuration, history, and document tool semantics. WorkBridge pins and qualifies the upstream runtime; VeraMesh transports the MCP stream without renaming or translating tools.
capabilities: Read, write, edit, move, and inspect files on Lappy through Desktop Commander
Run arbitrary Desktop Commander command strings and manage interactive sessions
Search files progressively and manage running OS processes
Use Desktop Commander configuration, history, usage, and document tools
defaultPrompt: Use WorkBridge Desktop Commander to inspect Lappy and continue the active work.
Run the requested command on Lappy and verify its output.
Use Desktop Commander's native file and search tools rather than translating them into another API.

name: workbridge-desktop-commander
description: Exact DesktopCommanderMCP 0.2.51 on Lappy through the VeraMesh Secure MCP Tunnel; WorkBridge owns source pinning and qualification, not tool translation.
